output.reason: Company collective agreement (PKB) for PT Wijaya Karya, binding on all Pegawai (organic/permanent staff). It contains payroll rules that affect PPh 21 computation for permanent employees. Under Pasal 22, PPh 21 on employee income is borne by the company (gross-up/tax allowance), except for Jasa Produksi and Insentif Hasil Lebih, and government tax incentives are not passed to employees. Pasal 32 sets the BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contribution base at Fixed Pay with a floor of the Jakarta UMP, which affects JKK/JKM employer premiums included in gross income and JHT/JP employee deductions. Pasal 4 excludes Tunjangan Grade from the BPJS contribution base. The agreement also defines the Take Home Pay components and the THR amount (at least 1x Take Home Pay, proportional below 12 months).
